purpose: Stacked source-only 1С extension boundary over the green durable runtime: pinned outbound HTTPS, exact discovery, exact leased-job receipts, static seven-command dispatch and a fail-closed configuration seam; no compiled compatibility claim, provider traffic or production activation.
requiredInvariants: The source represents outbound HTTPS only to the compile-time pinned production host with OS trust-store certificate validation; redirects and arbitrary paths are refused.
Machine and one-time lease bearers pass exact bounded header gates and are never logged, persisted by these modules or placed in a JSON body.
Every leased job includes the canonical payload hash, one-time lease bearer and lease expiry returned by the durable PostgreSQL authority.
ACK, result and fail use the exact server receipt envelope and X-One-C-Job-Lease header; replay uses a deterministic per-lease idempotency key.
No configuration business operation runs before a successful ACK, and an ambiguous ACK or terminal report never becomes local success.
The dispatcher contains exactly the seven canonical commands and no arbitrary RPC, dynamic procedure name, SQL, database dump or unrestricted read primitive.
Discovery and business operations remain fail-closed until one exact configuration and release are confirmed and separately accepted.
No direct information-base database access, real 1С data, provider traffic, production credential, production deployment, merge or certification claim is introduced.
This source-only slice does not claim a compiled CFE, 1С-side execution, licensed test-base acceptance or official 1С:Совместимо certification.
No new mandatory recurring cost is introduced.
